item.title: The Christians trying to take over
item.description: It’s a misconception that sexual depictions of minors are automatically legal just because they’re drawings, animations, or fictional. Federal law (18 U.S.C. § 1466A) and laws in multiple states specifically criminalize certain such depictions. The exact rules vary by jurisdiction and content, but “it’s just a drawing, so it’s legal” is not a valid blanket claim. Before this edit, I had mentioned that there are multiple people who have deleted comments that have been openly supporting this. That information has been saved. As a former military intelligence expert, digital forensics examiner, I assure you that if this issue is pushed, the information will be given the proper authorities based on jurisdiction on a case-by-case basis.(If you felt the need to DM me and try to get vile, this part of the message is for you. If not, move on.) It is absolutely abhorrent that any of you even try to remotely argue any semantics of this point. And it is extremely telling of whom you are. There is zero, absolutely zero, including quote-unquote therapeutic methods that involve any rendition of children in lewd or sexualized manners. If you believe this, you are sick and need help. If you don't want to get help, then being behind bars is the next best option. There is zero tolerance here. You will not change my mind.
